OtherNames: Little Aden LNG import terminal; Aden LNG receiving terminal
Location: Little Aden, Aden Governorate (terminal to connect via pipeline to the Little Aden power plant)
PowerPlantsSupplied: Little Aden power plant; planned 450 MW combined cycle power plant
ResearcherNotesProject: MoU signed 22 Nov 2023 in Cairo between Daewoo E&C (chairman Jung Won-ju) and Yemen's Ministry of Electricity & Energy to build an LNG import/receiving terminal + connecting pipeline to supply gas to the Little Aden power plant, plus a planned 450 MW CCGT. No capacity figure or FSRU/onshore configuration disclosed in the MoU coverage. Sponsor noted geopolitical uncertainty (ongoing war); MoU is a foundation to advance once conditions allow. A prior 2018 Aden FSRU EOI tender (PIF/govt; proposals due Jan 2018, to supply ~400 MW of Aden power plants) is the dormant predecessor concept for the same import need but is not the basis for this record. Distinct from the existing Balhaf/Yemen LNG export terminal (Shabwah). Capacity left blank pending a sourced figure.
